hobbies.hobby: hiking, camping, and national park enthusiast
hobbies.Why: I have always enjoyed the outdoors whether it's with my family, friends, or scouting troop and I hope to one day visit all of America's national parks!
I have a developed a strong liking to listening and playing classical works by Chopin, Liszt, Rachmaninoff, and more!
Towards the end of my junior year of high school, I started learning how to print on my Ender 3 and enjoyed learning how to print whatever I wanted!
I have enjoyed playing The Legend of Zelda, Geometry Dash, friendslop pc games, and horror games for years!
I enjoy the idea of thinking of something I want to make, and then actually making it! Learning how to program taught me how to make software I think is cool, useful or not!
